description: THE ROKHA BLOG (rokha.ai/news) — published posts, newest first. `official` posts are written by Rokha (each carries a `url` to read it); `featured` posts are builders' own write-ups that Rokha selected (each carries the builder's `external_url`). Filter with `kind` ('official' | 'featured'), `tag`, or `days` (only posts from the last N days, 1–90 — the recap rigs use it). RSS at /api/blog/rss.xml; builders submit their own posts for review at rokha.ai/news (signed in). Public, no auth.

days.description: Only posts published in the last N days.

kind.description: Only official posts or only featured builder posts.

page.description: Page number (24 per page by default).
